results.note: BLS PPI news release (USDL 26-1687, 08:30 ET Fri 13 Nov 2026): the PPI for final demand rose 0.3 percent in October, seasonally adjusted.
Ukrinform (13 Nov 08:39 Kyiv) repeats the Air Force morning summary: from 18:00 on 12 Nov Russia attacked with 117 strike UAVs (incl. 63 jet-powered), below 170.
GUS flash estimate for Q3 2026 (stat.gov.pl, 13 Nov): real GDP not seasonally adjusted (constant average prices of the previous year) rose 3.5% y/y.
The ČNB record of the 5 Nov 2026 meeting on cnb.cz states four members voted for the decision (Michl, Kubíček, Procházka, Seidler) and three, Zamrazilová, Frait and Kubelková, voted for stable rates.
Finance Ministry Cenový věstník částka 124 dated 13 Nov 2026 (cap set 14:00) sets the maximum price of B7 diesel for 14–16 Nov 2026 at 45.38 CZK/l incl. VAT.

Ukrinform (13 Nov 06:27 Kyiv), citing its correspondent, reports Zelensky's statement following talks with Witkoff and Kushner in Dublin, i.e. an in-person meeting on 12 Nov, inside the window; the presidential office also posted a read-out of the discussion.

Kyiv Independent (13 Nov 20:40 UTC) reports Costa announced that leaders at the informal Dublin meeting agreed EU institutions together with the E5 (France, Germany, Italy, Poland, UK) will jointly represent Europe in the peace negotiations; consilium.europa.eu refused scripted reading.

ČT24/ČTK (13 Nov, updated in the afternoon) report that at Friday's sitting deputies sent the government refinery-tax bill to third reading, with the opposition tabling about thirty amendments, i.e. the second reading was concluded; psp.cz was unreachable.
